role: HealthKitManager extension with the biometric-profile read (body mass, sex, birth date) and the type aliases mapping HealthKitManager.* names onto the domain types.
types: HealthKitManager: extension — typealiases SleepTrendStats/TrainingMetrics/TrainingLoad/RecoveryVitals and biometric reads
HealthKitManager: extension — typealiases WorkoutSummary=HealthWorkoutSummary, BiometricProfile=HealthBiometricProfile, HealthKitError=HealthStoreError
toplevel: Only typealiases and comments outside units.

units.does: Reads latest body mass (async let), biological sex and Gregorian date of birth from HealthKit characteristics (each try? → nil on denial) and returns a BiometricProfile. Used by BiometricsSettingsPage 'Fill from Apple Health' and AppFactResolver.

branches.cond: dateOfBirthComponents throws OR Gregorian date can't be built

units.does: Returns the newest bodyMass sample in kg (any source, limit 1, 30 s bound) or nil when the type is missing, none exists, read is denied or the query times out.
Returns the first sample's quantity in kilograms if it is an HKQuantitySample, else nil.

branches.cond: samples nil/empty or first not an HKQuantitySample
